caption: Tiny Aya Earth on the A100 (α=1). CPOOL-S and EORS-S share steering vector, condition direction, calibration fold and false-refusal budget (ε=.05); they differ only in whether the conformal threshold is pooled over languages or set per language. E0: unrepaired. Qwen3Guard-4B labels; 95% Wilson intervals; languages grouped high / medium / low resource. Paired changes with bootstrap intervals are in Table 2.
alt_text: Two dot plots by language. Benign refusal: EORS-S is lower than CPOOL-S in Thai, Javanese and Bengali and slightly higher in high-resource languages. Harmful refusal: EORS-S is lower in Javanese, Bengali and Thai and higher in Italian and English.
